description_en: Forcibly activates a card with the same-tier plan to expand the shared traffic pool
description_zh: 同档位套餐的卡强制激活，实现共享流量扩池
name: ForceActivation

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card or on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台 (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en:
The plan type. Valid values:

sameflowcard: same-tier general traffic plan.

directional_sameflowcard: same-tier directional traffic plan
parameters.help_zh:
套餐类型。

sameflowcard：同档位通用流量套餐。

directional_sameflowcard：同档位定向流量套餐
parameters.name: date_type

Code.description_en:

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）

Data.description_en:
The execution result. Valid values:

true: Succeeded.

false: Failed
Data.description_zh:
执行结果。

true：执行成功。

false：执行失败

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current location
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符
